meta_description: 560 likes, 9 comments - lonelyplanet on October 23, 2026: "Never been to the South Pacific? French Polynesia, one of Lonely Planet's 2027 Best in Travel picks, makes for a great first-time getaway. “People think of it as a far-flung luxury destination, but’s it’s actually only an eight-hour flight from LAX (take @airtahitinui), and you can make it affordable,” says Lonely Planet editor Jessica Lockhart (@wynnelockhart). Her tip? “If you’re headed to one of the less touristed islands, it pays to brush up on your French (or download a good translation app) and learn a few words of Ma’ohi (Tahitian).” Link in bio for her full itinerary 🔗".
